info.title: runware/runware-seedance-2.5
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "runware/runware-seedance-2.5", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: One Runware `videoInference` task, sent as a single JSON object. Router fills in the parts the model's path already decides: `taskType` is set to `videoInference`, `model` to this model's Runware AIR id, `deliveryMethod` to `async`, `includeCost` to `true` and `taskUUID` to a fresh UUID v4, overriding anything the body carries for those five. Router then polls the task to completion. `positivePrompt` is not required by this schema because image-driven submits may omit it; Runware refuses a submit it cannot run. Runware's other videoInference fields (`duration`, `resolution`, `inputs.frameImages`, `providerSettings`, ...) are accepted and forwarded unchanged; Runware validates them.

example.positivePrompt: A paper boat drifting down a rain-soaked street at dusk

model.description: Optional; always overridden with this model's Runware AIR id.

numberResults.description: Number of videos to generate (Runware's documented maximum for Seedance is 4). Each result is billed; the async poll waits for every generation and bills the sum of their costs.

positivePrompt.description: The prompt describing the video to generate. May be omitted for an image-driven submit, but not sent empty.

taskUUID.description: Optional; always overridden with a fresh Router-generated UUID v4, which the submit response carries and Router polls by. Runware documents this field as a UUID v4, so a value sent here must still match the pattern (version nibble `4`, variant nibble `[89abAB]`).

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
